# SD13-E4-F8 deterministic Human Cleric level 1 prepared divine spell-burden baseline
# fixture.
# Represents a deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Cleric level 1 identity as chosen
# input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity
# values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam (ability-bonus and bonus-feat)
# and stays a single-class, level-1-only prepared divine spell-bearing baseline.
#
# It deliberately avoids every prepared-caster or domain-power surface: no spell slots,
# no spells prepared, no channel-energy resolution, no domain power execution, no
# spontaneous cure / inflict accounting, no orisons / first-circle selection math. It
# adds only the minimum choice data needed to make the Cleric class identity, the
# prepared divine spell posture burden, and the domain choice burden legible; those
# burdens are intentionally left for the runtime and matrix to name as still blocking.
#
# The fixture deliberately names TWO domain choices (PF1 Cleric selects two domains at
# level 1) and a single deity / alignment selection. These are choice data only; this
# slice grounds no domain-power or prepared-caster resolution.
